title: RetroFuse OPS Mount Lookup Result
description: Schema for a single-record lookup result from the OPS mount index. Never contains the full index.

component_key.description: The exact lookup key provided in the request.

path.description: Canonical Windows path for the component. null when NOT_FOUND or AMBIGUOUS.

diff_path.description: Path to a diff artifact when diff_impact is PRESENT. null otherwise.

diff_impact.description: NONE: path is the last known location. PRESENT: a diff artifact exists at diff_path. UNKNOWN: cannot determine.

status.description: FOUND: single exact match. FOUND_WITH_DIFF: match with diff pointer. NOT_FOUND: no match. AMBIGUOUS: multiple matches. INVALID_INDEX: index file unreadable or malformed.

match_detail.description: Optional detail from the matching index record. Present only when status is FOUND or FOUND_WITH_DIFF.

section.description: Which index section contained the match: topLevel, surfaces, anchors, recent.

error.description: Human-readable error detail when status is INVALID_INDEX or AMBIGUOUS.
